subject: Launch readiness quick pulse — cross-functional owners and last-mile asks
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Cc: partners@marketplace-partners.com, simon@magnahealth.com
Date: Fri, 28 May 2027 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Launch readiness quick pulse — cross-functional owners and last-mile asks

Team — short, tactical pulse to align on next 6 hours before the exec sync at 15:00 PT. Please read and reply inline with red/amber/green and single-line blockers + owner. High-level: we need go/no-go signals on GTM assets, enablement, pricing guardrails, docs + support runbook.

1) GTM (Karthik) — status: amber. Ask: confirm final launch one-pager and demo script by 11:30.
2) Enablement (Marissa) — status: amber. Ask: publish enablement deck + hands-on lab by 13:00. Attach: enablement-deck-v1.pdf (draft).
3) Pricing (Laura) — status: red. Ask: decision on discount cap and approval for emergency promo (see pricing-exception-table.xlsx).
4) Docs (Monica) — status: green. Ask: add final API examples for private deployment by 12:00. Link in related_links.
5) Support & On-call (Ben) — status: amber. Ask: runbook draft reviewed and escalation matrix finalized by 14:00. Attach: support-runbook-draft.md

External note to Simon @ MagnaHealth and marketplace partners — we are coordinating the last-mile items above; you should expect the integration checklist by EOD. No action required from you until we confirm.

If you have a hard blocker that is not resolvable by your function lead within the timeline, flag it as ESCALATE and call me. Otherwise, reply with a one-line status update.

— Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
VP, GTM Operations | Redwood Inference
(h) 415-555-0112
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 28 May 2027 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Launch readiness quick pulse — cross-functional owners and last-mile asks

Hannah — quick status.
- GTM: AMBER (owner: k_iyer). Demo script is at 90% — need a final line on fallback messaging when latencies spike (Paul Ops asked). I can finalize by 11:30 if Laura confirms price communication wording (see Q2 pricing exception).
- Sales enablement pathing: I want the one-pager trimmed to one page (lead-gen focus) — Marissa, can you provide the trimmed PDF by 11:00?

Blocker: Pricing red prevents finalizing external comms. If pricing caps are not decided by 12:00, we'll need to ship with conservative uplift language and a follow-up PR. Marking potential ESCALATE for leadership if not resolved.

Karthik
Head of GTM Strategy
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 28 May 2027 11:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Launch readiness quick pulse — cross-functional owners and last-mile asks

All — ENABLEMENT status update: AMBER -> will be GREEN after two items.
- Deck: enablement-deck-v1.pdf attached (draft). I added two product walkthroughs and a TL;DR cheat sheet. Final edits in comments on the Drive link.
- Hands-on lab: environment provisioning has one terraform var mismatch (internal infra ticket #INF-882). If infra fixes by 12:30, lab ready by 13:00.

Deliverables I will produce before 13:00: 1) trimmed 1-pager for Karthik, 2) updated speaker notes for SDRs, 3) annotated walkthrough recording (link will follow). If pricing language changes materially, I’ll hold the external-facing slides until confirmed.

Marissa Cole
Senior Manager, Enablement
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 28 May 2027 12:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Launch readiness quick pulse — cross-functional owners and last-mile asks

Team — PRICING: RED (owner: laura_bennett). Short rationale and concrete asks below.
- Issue: MagnaHealth procurement asked for immediate commitment to a 25% onboarding credit for first 3 months. That is outside our current SLA pricing guardrails.
- Impact: If we grant this, it creates a precedent and potentially reduces ARR visibility for this quarter.
- Asks for leadership: 1) Approve a one-time exception limited to the MagnaHealth deal (MAG-2027-0421) with a maximum cap of $40k, OR 2) Reject the concession and offer a shorter, conditional credit tied to usage thresholds.

Attached: pricing-exception-table.xlsx with scenario modelling. I need a decision by 13:00 to finalize GTM external comms. If no decision, I recommend we default to option 2 and proceed with conservative language to avoid over-committing.

Laura Bennett
Head of Pricing and Packaging
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 28 May 2027 14:48:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Launch readiness quick pulse — cross-functional owners and last-mile asks

Short confirm: SUPPORT status -> AMBER but stabilizing. Runbook draft (support-runbook-draft.md) includes playbook for throttling, latency fallbacks, and a two-step escalation to SRE + Customer Success. I will push the runbook to the shared Drive and notify on-call leads by 15:00.

Notes: we have one outstanding item — a phone-win routing test with the MagnaHealth integration environment (ticket SUP-334). If that fails, we fallback to manual support routing and a 30-min SLA for high-priority incidents for launch day.

If pricing chooses option 1 (exception), we need an addendum to the runbook to reflect billing adjustments; ping finance and legal.

Ben Carter
Director, Customer Support & Ops
